title: Born into a cornet-playing family uptown
summary: Lee gives his birth date and streets; his father and grandfather played cornet and he started on his father's horn at six or seven.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh, it's going? Yeah. Hello, this is Lee Collins talking here. I was born in Deeroux, New Orleans, October 17, 1901. I was raised uptown. I'm almost born with a cornet. My daddy was a cornet player, my grandfather was a cornet player. They played with the old Tio boys, Lorenzo Tio's daddy and his uncle. And I started blowing all my old, my daddy's cornet when I was around about six or seven, six or seven years old. And I kept on playing and playing.
About what street were you born on?
I was born on Della Chaves in Robeson. Oh yes. And I was raised on Losing Avenue between Threatt and Robeson.
